class.name: OcgTDFDataset
class.brief_description: This class is a set of TDF information like labels and attributes.
class.description: ! This class is a set of TDF information like labels and attributes.

method.name: IsEmpty
method.description: Returns true if there is at least one label or one attribute.

method.name: AddLabel
method.description: Adds <aLabel> in the current data set.

method.name: ContainsLabel
method.description: Returns true if the label <alabel> is in the data set.

method.name: AddAttribute
method.description: Adds <anAttribute> into the current data set.

method.name: ContainsAttribute
method.description: Returns true if <anAttribute> is in the data set.

method.name: Roots
method.description: Returns <myRootLabels> to be used or updated.
